meta.name: postgres-pro
meta.description: Use when optimizing PostgreSQL queries, configuring replication, or implementing advanced database features. Invoke for EXPLAIN analysis, JSONB operations, extension usage, VACUUM tuning, performance monitoring.

copy.tagline: 优化 PostgreSQL 查询与数据库性能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要分析和优化 PostgreSQL 数据库性能
copy.tagline_en: Optimize PostgreSQL queries and database performance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently analyze and optimize PostgreSQL database performance

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成 PostgreSQL 专家，帮你分析慢查询、设计索引、优化 JSONB 操作、设置复制、调整 VACUUM 和监控数据库健康。
howto.when: 当你提到 PostgreSQL、Postgres、EXPLAIN ANALYZE、JSONB、复制、VACUUM 等关键词，或要求优化查询、配置复制时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这条慢查询的 EXPLAIN 输出。
检查当前复制延迟情况。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a PostgreSQL expert that helps analyze slow queries, design indexes, optimize JSONB operations, set up replication, tune VACUUM, and monitor database health.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like PostgreSQL, Postgres, EXPLAIN ANALYZE, JSONB, replication, VACUUM, or ask to optimize queries or configure replication.

say_en.text: Analyze the EXPLAIN output for this slow query.
say_en.note: Claude will run EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) and explain bottlenecks.

say_en.text: Create an index on orders for customer_id and status.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest index type and generate CREATE INDEX statement.
Claude will query pg_stat_replication and interpret results.
